channel.title: Kenya - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Kenya, every source cited.

item.title: Husband arrested over wife's shallow grave burial
item.description: Detectives in Kajiado County arrested Shon David Rabassa Kioko after a farmhand reported the incident.

item.title: Kenya develops national coffee flavour atlas
item.description: The initiative will document diverse coffee profiles from 34 counties, with findings published in 2027.

item.title: Kenya launches pesticide residue monitoring framework
item.description: New system aims to improve food safety and protect horticultural exports from rejections.

item.title: CIP and Crop Trust develop climate-resilient potatoes in Kenya
item.description: The BOLD project will use wild potato relatives to breed varieties resistant to heat, unpredictable rain, pests, and diseases.
